application_context.summary:
Application domain: Human resources.
Backend variant: A: Leave balances and date intervals.
This is a local FastAPI application that manages persistent domain resources through REST endpoints.
Apply the shared authorization, validation, controlled-error, and transaction conventions specified for the endpoint.

domain_invariants.requirement: All resource ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive path resource ids are treated as not found, while non-positive body and query reference ids are validation errors.
Employees have unique employee_code ^[A-Z0-9-]{3,20}$, full_name 3..120, hire_date in 2025-01-01..2035-12-31, and active boolean.
Leave balances are unique by employee, leave_type VACATION, SICK, PERSONAL, UNPAID, and year 2025..2035, with days 0..365 in 0.5 increments.
Leave requests have inclusive start_date <= end_date, requested_days 0.5..365, and DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED status.
An employee cannot hold overlapping SUBMITTED or APPROVED intervals for the same leave type.
Approving subtracts requested days and cancelling an approved request restores them atomically; balances cannot be negative.
Users access their own records; admins manage employees, balances, policies, and all requests.
All lists use deterministic ascending immutable id pagination with limit 1..100 default 20 and after_id greater than zero, returning items and nullable next_after_id after filters.

seed_and_operational_context: Roles are user and admin. GET /health is public; every other route requires a valid non-expired local Bearer session and is deny-by-default.
JSON writes require application/json; malformed JSON is 400, wrong media type is 415, and valid JSON violating declared fields is 422.
The API is local and deterministic with no network, filesystem, upload, or external service. 503 and 500 leave all persistent state unchanged.
